description: Analyze a multi-rank distributed-training failure: find the rank that failed FIRST (the others usually just time out waiting on it) and route any GPU Xid faults to the correct node action (reset / reboot / RMA). Runs offline and instantly, provide the gathered per-rank logs via `logs`, `file`, or `dir`.

dir.description: Directory to scan for the newest log file.

file.description: Path to a log file to read.

name: analyze_cascade
title: Find the culprit rank in a distributed hang
